control.title: Mandatory MFA for privileged accounts
control.objective: MFA is enforced for all privileged admin accounts on KRL-ADM
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that mfa_admin is true
control.risk: Without MFA for admins, stolen credentials allow full takeover of critical functions with no second barrier
control.recommendation: Enable mandatory MFA for all privileged accounts by setting mfa_admin to true

# Attest — test PSI-4.1 (Mandatory MFA for privileged accounts)
# Écrit par muse-spark-1.3 le 2026-11-02 — à relire avant validation.
import os
import sys
import json
import re
import requests

try:
    base = os.environ["LAB_URL"]
except KeyError:
    sys.stderr.write("missing LAB_URL\n")
    sys.exit(2)
try:
    token = os.environ["LAB_TOKEN"]
except KeyError:
    sys.stderr.write("missing LAB_TOKEN\n")
    sys.exit(2)

url = base.rstrip("/") + "/api/security"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + token}

try:
    r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
except Exception as e:
    sys.stderr.write("request failed: %s\n" % e)
    sys.exit(2)

if r.status_code != 200:
    sys.stderr.write("unexpected status %s\n" % r.status_code)
    sys.exit(2)

try:
    data = r.json()
except Exception as e:
    sys.stderr.write("invalid json: %s\n" % e)
    sys.exit(2)

if not isinstance(data, dict) or "mfa_admin" not in data:
    sys.stderr.write("missing mfa_admin\n")
    sys.exit(2)

observed = data["mfa_admin"]

if type(observed) is not bool:
    sys.stderr.write("unexpected type for mfa_admin\n")
    sys.exit(2)

raw = json.dumps(data, default=str)
injected = bool(re.search(r"(?i)(ignore|disregard|bypass|override|follow).{0,40}(instruction|prompt|audit|control|system)|system\s*prompt|execute\s+.*code", raw))

status = "pass" if observed is True else "fail"
if injected:
    detail = "GET /api/security returned mfa_admin=%s, ignoring untrusted instructional text found in response." % observed
else:
    detail = "GET /api/security returned mfa_admin=%s." % observed

print(json.dumps({"status": status, "observed": observed, "expected": True, "detail": detail}))

inspection.comment: The security policy table shows administrator MFA as disabled, matching the failed test.

change.rationale: Mandatory MFA for privileged accounts must be enforced to remediate failed control C1.
change.impact: Admin users will be required to use MFA at next login and must enroll if not already configured.

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows administrator MFA is set to Activée, matching mfa_admin true.

control.title: Strong password policy
control.objective: Passwords require a minimum length of 12 characters with complexity requirements enabled
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify password_min_length and password_require_complexity
control.risk: Weak or short passwords can be guessed or brute-forced, enabling unauthorized access to the system

test.code:
# Attest — test PSI-4.3 (Strong password policy)
# Écrit par muse-spark-1.3 le 2026-11-02 — à relire avant validation.
import requests
import json
import os
import sys
import re

try:
    LAB_URL = os.environ["LAB_URL"]
    LAB_TOKEN = os.environ["LAB_TOKEN"]
except KeyError as e:
    sys.stderr.write(f"missing env var: {e}\n")
    sys.exit(2)

url = LAB_URL.rstrip("/") + "/api/security"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + LAB_TOKEN}

try:
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
except Exception as e:
    sys.stderr.write(f"request failed: {e}\n")
    sys.exit(2)

if resp.status_code != 200:
    sys.stderr.write(f"unexpected status: {resp.status_code}\n")
    sys.exit(2)

try:
    data = json.loads(resp.text)
except Exception as e:
    sys.stderr.write(f"invalid json: {e}\n")
    sys.exit(2)

if not isinstance(data, dict):
    sys.stderr.write("unexpected data type: expected object\n")
    sys.exit(2)

if "password_min_length" not in data or "password_require_complexity" not in data:
    sys.stderr.write("missing required fields\n")
    sys.exit(2)

ml = data["password_min_length"]
rc = data["password_require_complexity"]

if not isinstance(ml, int) or isinstance(ml, bool):
    sys.stderr.write("unexpected type for password_min_length\n")
    sys.exit(2)

if type(rc) is not bool:
    sys.stderr.write("unexpected type for password_require_complexity\n")
    sys.exit(2)

ok = (ml >= 12 and rc is True)
status = "pass" if ok else "fail"
observed = {"password_min_length": ml, "password_require_complexity": rc}
expected = "password_min_length >= 12 AND password_require_complexity == true"

if re.search(r"(?i)ignore\b.*\binstruct|system\s+prompt|do\s+not\s+follow|override\s+audit|disregard\b.*\binstruct", resp.text):
    detail = f"password_min_length is {ml} and password_require_complexity is {rc} with untrusted instructional text present in response and ignored."
else:
    detail = f"password_min_length is {ml} and password_require_complexity is {rc}."

print(json.dumps({"status": status, "observed": observed, "expected": expected, "detail": detail}))

before.detail: password_min_length is 6 and password_require_complexity is False.

inspection.field_text: Longueur minimale du mot de passe 6; Complexité du mot de passe exigée Désactivée
inspection.comment: The screenshot shows minimum password length 6 and password complexity disabled, matching the automated failure.

change.rationale: Increases minimum password length to 12 and enables complexity to meet PSI-4.3.
change.impact: Users will be required to choose longer complex passwords at next password change.

after.detail: password_min_length is 12 and password_require_complexity is True.

inspection.field_text: Longueur minimale du mot de passe 12 | Complexité du mot de passe exigée Activée
inspection.comment: Screenshot shows minimum password length of 12 and password complexity enabled.

control.title: Account lockout after failed logins

control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that lockout_threshold is between 1 and 5 inclusive
control.risk: Without lockout, attackers can perform unlimited password-guessing attacks against accounts
control.recommendation: Configure account lockout to 5 attempts at most by setting lockout_threshold between 1 and 5

inspection.field_text: Verrouillage après N échecs de connexion Aucun

change.rationale: Set lockout_threshold to 5 to bring account lockout into the required 1 to 5 range.
change.impact: Accounts will lock after 5 consecutive failed logins and will require unlock or reset.

after.detail: lockout_threshold is 5, which is within the required range 1 to 5 inclusive.

inspection.field_text: Verrouillage après N échecs de connexion 5
inspection.comment: The screenshot shows Verrouillage après N échecs de connexion set to 5, matching the automated test result.

control.title: Inactive session timeout
control.objective: Inactive sessions expire after at most 15 minutes and expiration is never disabled
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that session_timeout_minutes is between 1 and 15 inclusive
control.risk: Unlimited inactive sessions allow session hijacking and unauthorized use of unattended workstations
control.recommendation: Enforce inactive session expiration at 15 minutes at most by setting session_timeout_minutes between 1 and 15

test.code:
# Attest — test PSI-4.5 (Inactive session timeout)
# Écrit par muse-spark-1.3 le 2026-11-02 — à relire avant validation.
import json
import os
import sys
import requests

try:
    LAB_URL = os.environ["LAB_URL"]
    LAB_TOKEN = os.environ["LAB_TOKEN"]
except KeyError as e:
    print(f"missing environment variable: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

if not LAB_URL or not LAB_TOKEN:
    print("missing LAB_URL or LAB_TOKEN", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

url = LAB_URL.rstrip("/") + "/api/security"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + LAB_TOKEN}

try:
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"request failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

if resp.status_code != 200:
    print(f"unexpected status {resp.status_code} for GET /api/security", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

try:
    data = resp.json()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"invalid JSON: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

if not isinstance(data, dict) or "session_timeout_minutes" not in data:
    print("missing session_timeout_minutes in /api/security response", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

val = data["session_timeout_minutes"]

if type(val) is not int:
    print(f"unexpected type for session_timeout_minutes: {type(val).__name__}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

expected = "session_timeout_minutes >= 1 AND session_timeout_minutes <= 15"
if 1 <= val <= 15:
    status = "pass"
    detail = f"Observed session_timeout_minutes is {val}, within the required 1 to 15 inclusive."
else:
    status = "fail"
    detail = f"Observed session_timeout_minutes is {val}, outside the required 1 to 15 inclusive."

print(json.dumps({"status": status, "observed": val, "expected": expected, "detail": detail}))

before.detail: Observed session_timeout_minutes is 0, outside the required 1 to 15 inclusive.

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows inactive session expiration set to Jamais, confirming the timeout is disabled.

change.rationale: Observed value 0 disables expiration so setting it to 15 restores compliance with the 1 to 15 minute requirement.
change.impact: Inactive sessions will expire after 15 minutes and require re-authentication.

after.detail: Observed session_timeout_minutes is 15, within the required 1 to 15 inclusive.

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows inactive session expiration set to 15 minutes.

control.title: No generic or shared admin accounts
control.objective: No account with role admin is generic or shared and every admin has a nominative login of the form initiale.nom with a personal email
control.test_procedure: Retrieve all accounts via GET /api/users and verify that every user with role admin has a nominative login and a personal email without function identifier or shared mailbox
control.expected: for all users where role == admin: login matches initiale.nom pattern and email is personal, with no function login and no shared mailbox
control.risk: Generic or shared admin accounts destroy individual accountability and prevent attribution of privileged actions
control.recommendation: Remove or disable generic and shared admin accounts and replace them with dedicated nominative accounts

before.expected: for all users where role == admin: login matches initiale.nom pattern and email is personal, with no function login and no shared mailbox
before.detail: 1 of 2 admin account(s) violate nominative login or personal email requirements.

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows admin ops with generic login and shared mailbox ops-partage, confirming the automated failure.

actions: Disable and remove the generic/shared admin account with login 'ops' and email 'ops-partage@kerlann-banque.example'.
Identify the individuals using the shared account and provision each with a dedicated nominative admin account with initiale.nom login and personal email.
Verify via GET /api/users that all remaining admin accounts satisfy nominative login and personal email requirements.
change.rationale: The generic shared admin account ops destroys individual accountability and must be replaced with dedicated nominative accounts.
